meta.note: The one source of every design value of Lone Bee. scripts/tokens.js turns it into site/css/tokens.css and the palette files; the art reads its palette. Ramps list each ramp darkest first. Every contrast pair below is checked by the script.

tokens.name: comb-black
tokens.usage: Palette, Propolis ramp. Sunken surfaces, text on gold, the deepest shadow and the bee's eye.

tokens.name: hive
tokens.usage: Palette, Propolis ramp. The page background, and the last rows of the hero art so the scene melts into the page.

tokens.name: propolis
tokens.usage: Palette, Propolis ramp. Raised surfaces; near hills in the art.

tokens.name: bark
tokens.usage: Palette, Propolis ramp. Hover surfaces and platform tags; the dark bands of the bee.

tokens.name: umber
tokens.usage: Palette, Propolis ramp. Decorative frames and dividers; the bee's head and legs.

tokens.name: tawny
tokens.usage: Palette, Propolis ramp. Control borders; highlights on the bee's head and antennae.

tokens.name: burnt-comb
tokens.usage: Palette, Honey ramp. The hard shadow of the hero title; in the art, the shaded rock of the summits in the glow and the thorax's shadow.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Palette, Honey ramp. The ledge under gold buttons; the bee's thorax and the rock that burns in the glow.

tokens.name: marmalade
tokens.usage: Palette, Honey ramp. Warnings, always with a word or a glyph; band shading and sun glow in the art.

tokens.name: honey
tokens.usage: Palette, Honey ramp. Filled comb cells and honey badges; the bee's bands and the sun's glow.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Palette, Honey ramp. The one accent: primary buttons and the bee's highlights. Once or twice per screen.

tokens.name: pollen
tokens.usage: Palette, Honey ramp. The accent on hover; backlit wings, pollen loads, sunlit snow and the sun's halo.

tokens.name: old-wax
tokens.usage: Palette, Beeswax ramp. Faint text: disabled labels and fine print; seed heads in the art.

tokens.name: wax
tokens.usage: Palette, Beeswax ramp. Muted text.

tokens.name: beeswax
tokens.usage: Palette, Beeswax ramp. Text and the wordmark.

tokens.name: sunlight
tokens.usage: Palette, Beeswax ramp. Art only: the sun's disc and the brightest glints.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Palette, Dusk ramp. The top of the hero sky, under the header, and the low ridge under its copy.

tokens.name: dusk
tokens.usage: Palette, Dusk ramp. The flat sky the hero title sits on.

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Palette, Dusk ramp. Sky bands; the cool rim that keeps the bee's dark parts off dark grounds.

tokens.name: deep-teal
tokens.usage: Palette, Dusk ramp. Sky bands and wing veins.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Palette, Dusk ramp. Success, always with a word or a glyph; the low sky.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Palette, Dusk ramp. Links; the wings' leading edge and the stars.

tokens.name: glint
tokens.usage: Palette, Dusk ramp. Focus rings and links on hover; specular glints and the evening star.

tokens.name: moss
tokens.usage: Palette, Meadow ramp. Art only: grass blades and stems in shade.

tokens.name: grass
tokens.usage: Palette, Meadow ramp. Art only: grass.

tokens.name: sunlit-grass
tokens.usage: Palette, Meadow ramp. Art only: grass tips lit by the low sun.

tokens.name: wine
tokens.usage: Palette, Heather ramp. Art only: summits and hills in shade, the lone pine, cloud tops, and the deepest cores of the bee's bands.

tokens.name: heather
tokens.usage: Palette, Heather ramp. Art only: clouds, heather and ling, and summits in shade.

tokens.name: lavender
tokens.usage: Palette, Heather ramp. Art only: ling (the heather of the summer pastures, and of their honey), gentians, and snow in shade.

tokens.name: clover
tokens.usage: Palette, Clover ramp. Art only: clover flowers and hill crests near the sun.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Palette, Clover ramp. Errors, always with a word or a glyph; cloud bellies and flowers.

tokens.name: peach
tokens.usage: Palette, Clover ramp. Art only: the horizon band, cloud bellies, and snow in shade near the sun.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Also the browser's theme color.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards and secondary buttons.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: A raised surface under the pointer; platform tags.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Sunken surfaces: the footer and the wells behind game art.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative frames and dividers (2.11:1 on bg): never a control's only edge.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control frames, and the dotted frame of games in the works (3.75:1 on bg, 3.31:1 on surface).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Text on bg (14.88:1), surface (13.15:1), surface-hover, sunken and the hero sky.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on bg (9.00:1), surface (7.95:1), surface-hover, sunken and the hero sky.

tokens.name: text-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and fine print on bg, surface or sunken. Never for anything a reader needs.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary buttons and accent marks on bg and surface (11.55:1 on bg). Once or twice per screen.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: A primary button under the pointer.

tokens.name: accent-edge
tokens.usage: The hard ledge under a primary button.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent (12.46:1), accent-hover and honey.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Text links on bg (10.24:1), surface and sunken, underlined.

tokens.name: link-hover
tokens.usage: A text link under the pointer.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The focus ring, solid, on every ground: bg 14.71:1, surface 13.00:1, the hero sky 11.68:1.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success, on bg or surface, always with a word or a check glyph.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warnings, on bg or surface, always with a word or a glyph: gold's neighbor in the ramp.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, on bg or surface, always with a word or a cross glyph.

tokens.name: hero-sky
tokens.usage: The flat sky behind the hero copy.

tokens.name: sky-top
tokens.usage: The header bar of the home page, and the hero box under its art: the same night as the art's top rows, so the sky runs on behind the logo, and a band left above the art reads as more sky.

families.body: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
families.mono: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The hero title from 720px wide. Jersey 10 is pixel-crisp when its size in device pixels is a multiple of 56: 56px and 112px at whole-number pixel ratios. No other size, except display-m.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Section titles and card titles; the hero title under 720px.

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: Card titles under 480px only: crisp at 2x, a little soft at 1x and 3x.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: The hero tagline and section leads.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: A daily puzzle: read a tiny C function, paint its output on an 8×8 grid.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: © Lone Bee · No cookies · Crafted with love in the Pyrenees

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code and truth tables, on sunken.

spacing.note: A 4px grid. Most of the page uses space-4, space-6 and space-12.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a tag's text and its edge; tight icon gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between tags and between nav links; above the buttons in a card.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside buttons, vertically; nav link padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; between a title and its text; the header's padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; inside buttons, horizontally; between buttons.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between a section title and its content; between cards.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Around the hero copy.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between sections on phones.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Between sections.

border.note: One UI pixel is 2px: every line, frame and notch is drawn in it.

tokens.name: pixel
tokens.usage: One UI pixel: frames, borders, notches, dotted frame dots, text underlines.

tokens.name: drop
tokens.usage: Two UI pixels: the hard drop of buttons and the distance a pressed button travels.

tokens.name: focus-width
tokens.usage: The focus ring's width: one UI pixel of glint.

tokens.name: focus-offset
tokens.usage: The focus ring's gap around links and plain controls.

tokens.name: focus-offset-button
tokens.usage: The focus ring's gap around buttons: past their frame and drop.

radius.note: Nothing is rounded: corners are square or notched by one UI pixel.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Every corner. Notches come from the frame shadows, never from a radius.

shadow.note: Hard shadows only: no blur, no spread past one UI pixel. The four 2px offsets around a box draw a frame with notched corners.

tokens.name: shadow-frame
tokens.usage: A notched umber frame around cards.

tokens.name: shadow-frame-strong
tokens.usage: A notched tawny frame around controls.

tokens.name: shadow-button
tokens.usage: A primary button: its gold fill grown by a notched frame, over a notched amber drop.

tokens.name: shadow-button-hover
tokens.usage: A primary button under the pointer.

tokens.name: shadow-button-pressed
tokens.usage: A pressed primary button, moved by drop onto its own shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-button-secondary
tokens.usage: A secondary button: a surface fill in a notched tawny frame, over a notched comb-black drop.

tokens.name: shadow-button-secondary-hover
tokens.usage: A secondary button under the pointer: its frame turns beeswax.

tokens.name: shadow-button-secondary-pressed
tokens.usage: A pressed secondary button, moved by drop onto its own shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-title
tokens.usage: The hero title's hard shadow (text-shadow).

tokens.name: shadow-title-small
tokens.usage: The hard shadow of section titles (text-shadow).

layout.note: One column of content, left aligned, with a full-width hero.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: The widest the content column grows.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: The side gutter from 600px wide.

tokens.name: gutter-narrow
tokens.usage: The side gutter on phones.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: The longest line of running text.

tokens.name: hero-min
tokens.usage: The shortest the hero art gets.

tokens.name: hero-wide-min
tokens.usage: The shortest the hero gets on wide screens, where the copy sits on the art.

tokens.name: hero-fluid
tokens.usage: The hero art's height under 1100px, between hero-min and hero-max.

tokens.name: hero-wide-fluid
tokens.usage: The hero's height from 1100px wide, where it fits: 2:1, the art's own shape.

tokens.name: hero-max
tokens.usage: The tallest the hero art gets under 1100px, so the games stay near the fold; from 1100px, the least the hero may grow to on short screens.

tokens.name: hero-fold
tokens.usage: From 1100px, the hero grows up to the first screen: the viewport under the 96px header bar (its 64px logo, space-4 above and below), plus 2vw, the art's six rows of hive at its scale, which may hang below the fold since they are the page's own color.

tokens.name: hero-bee-min
tokens.usage: From 1100px, the least the hero's height cap gets, however short the screen: the art is pinned to its bottom right and loses its top, and at this height no screen width crops the bee, at a browser zoom of 67% or more.

tokens.name: mark-size
tokens.usage: The bee mark in the header: its 32px art at 2x.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: The smallest height of a link or button people tap.

tokens.name: layer-under
tokens.usage: Under an element's own content, inside it: a button's hit area, under its label.

tokens.name: layer-art
tokens.usage: The hero art.

tokens.name: layer-content
tokens.usage: Text and controls laid over the hero art.

tokens.name: layer-skip
tokens.usage: The skip link, over everything once focused.
